svg.text: ECAN inference: independent checks and cross-frame replicas
2026-10-07 recorded data. Blue: first 2 captures. Orange: later captures, including readable prefix only.
Load is shown in proxy counts, not Nm. Voltage/RPM meanings retain source and calibration uncertainty.
Correlations alone do not identify an ECU or establish every field meaning. Host stamps are not hardware CAN arrival times.
